title: pilosella vaillantii subsp. cymigera
intro: Pilosella vaillantii subsp. cymigera, commonly known as a type of thistle, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella vaillantii subsp. cymigera include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
